items.prompt: What do you do — are you working or studying at the moment?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you find difficult or stressful about it?
Do you think you'll still be doing the same thing in five years? Why or why not?
What's one skill you'd like to improve, and how would you go about it?
What do you usually do in your free time?
How did you first get interested in that?
Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with other people? Why?
Is there a hobby you used to enjoy but don't do anymore? What happened?
Is there something new you'd like to try in the future?
Can you tell me a little about the place where you grew up?
What do you like most about living there — or wherever you live now?
Has the area changed much since you were younger?
Would you like to live somewhere else one day? Where, and why?
What are you most looking forward to in the next year or two?
